translation_snapshot.source:
Reduces the casting speed of the selected chronomancy spell by %d%%.
		Each spell can only be spellbound in one way at a time.
		
		Current Quickened Spell: %s
translation_snapshot.target:
强化指定的时空系法术，减少施放指定法术需要的时间 %d%%。
		每个技能只能附加一种时空增效系效果。
		
		当前强化法术：%s

translation_snapshot.source:
Reduces the cooldown of the selected chronomancy spell by %d%%.
		Each spell can only be spellbound in one way at a time.
		
		Current Matrix Spell: %s
translation_snapshot.target:
强化指定的时空系法术，减少指定法术的冷却时间 %d%%。
		每个技能只能附加一种时空增效系效果。
		
		当前强化法术：%s

translation_snapshot.source:
Load incendiary ammunition, causing attacks to deal an additional %d%% weapon damage as fire in a radius %d ball around your target. 
		This cannot trigger more than once per turn.
		The damage will scale with your Physical Power.
translation_snapshot.target:
装填燃烧弹，对目标附近的敌人造成 %d%% 火焰武器伤害，范围最大为 %d。
		该技能每回合最多触发一次。
		伤害受物理强度加成。

translation_snapshot.source: a logical analysis of creation, by philosopher Smythen
translation_snapshot.target: 创世传说的逻辑分析，哲学家斯迈森著

translation_snapshot.source: Target is watched, causing the next talent used to fail and trigger a counterattack.
translation_snapshot.target: 目标被警戒，下一次使用技能将被打断，并触发被反击。
